purpose: Freeze how admitted Pandora spectral-radiance uncertainty will be propagated to photopic, scotopic and Johnson-V channels before any selected radiance or per-pixel uncertainty value is opened, while refusing undocumented independence assumptions.

linearity.photopic: the frozen direct trapezoid is a linear functional of the sampled spectral radiance once the wavelength grid is fixed
linearity.scotopic: the frozen direct trapezoid is a linear functional of the sampled spectral radiance once the wavelength grid is fixed
linearity.johnsonV: effective_inband_radiance is a linear functional of sampled radiance because the response*lambda denominator depends only on the frozen wavelength/passband grid

documentedComponentCovariance.rule: propagate each documented covariance block as sqrt(w^T C_k w); combine blocks by RSS only when their statistical independence is explicitly documented before opening

perPixelOneSigmaWithNoCorrelationDocumen.interpretation: maximum-correlation upper bound; do not use sqrt(sum_i((w_i*sigma_i)^2)) without documented independence
perPixelOneSigmaWithNoCorrelationDocumen.reason: for arbitrary correlations bounded by magnitude 1, the standard deviation of a weighted sum is bounded above by the L1 sum of absolute weighted standard deviations

crossSpectrometerRule.ifOnlyPerPixelOneSigmaAndNoCrossCorrelat: apply the same L1 maximum-correlation upper bound across all weighted s1+s2 samples used by the hard metadata splice

channelRelativeAndLogConversion.reason: preserve the same positive-channel lognormal one-sigma conversion already used by the prior pre-opening Level-B empirical evaluator; a conservative upper bound on relative sigma yields a conservative upper bound on log sigma

wavelengthUncertaintyBoundary.ifLEVEL1InstrumentUncertaintyAlreadyProp: do not add a duplicate wavelength term
wavelengthUncertaintyBoundary.ifSeparateWavelengthCalibrationUncertain: its exact covariance/common-shift semantics and deterministic channel propagation must be bound from PGN calibration documentation before opening; do not improvise from residuals
